reachable_path: execute plain environment inherits real HOME; source/control git head/status use /usr/bin/git without isolating user/system/local executable configuration
scope: Static reachable config path, not an observed GitHub-host failure
required: Per-command whitelist environment with global/system config disabled and no inherited Git config injection
Strict non-following Gitdir/local-config guard: reject includes, executable helpers, filters/textconv, fsmonitor, ssh helpers, partial-clone/worktree indirection
Account for .git/info/attributes/exclude, commondir/config.worktree/alternates as fresh-checkout metadata sources
Do not leak rejected http.extraHeader/credentials/URL secrets; retain config hash and safe key names only
negative_cases: HOME global fsmonitor would otherwise launch external command
Local include/includeIf/exec filter/textconv/fsmonitor rejected before Git process
Local gitdir/config/worktree/attribute link/indirection rejected before reads
Inherited GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/PARAMETERS cannot reenter child env
Credential-like config values never copied to public receipts
